title: Ask toward an open problem: The exponent of matrix multiplication
statement: Propose five candidate un-asked questions, each smaller than the open problem below and each such that its answer would bear on it. Problem OP-CS-OMEGA: Is the exponent omega of matrix multiplication equal to 2? Each candidate must pass the Depth requirement of LEDGER.md, must not be a duplicate of ledger/INDEX.md, must not be the problem itself or a known reformulation of it, and must carry a bears_on link to OP-CS-OMEGA saying how its answer would bear on the problem.

problem_source.title: A Refined Laser Method and Faster Matrix Multiplication
